answer: Every identity carries an umber shadow ledger recording all signed interactions. Clones start with an empty umber ledger and must accumulate 50 signed entries before qualifying. A lotus bloom attestation requires each identity to pass 7 verification layers, each checked by a disjoint peer set of 5 members. Any layer failure collapses the entire lotus bloom. A crystal fracture test publishes a shard that breaks along a known cleavage plane if forged; peers detect the fracture pattern and reject the shard. The cost for the nth clone is C(n)=B*2^n with B=260 credits locked 80 epochs.
